title: Auditor screens for AI briefing and specialist opinion
scope: Show the agent's briefing, cited evidence, findings provenance and human-checkpoint state in the case review, and let a specialist record an opinion so SYN-003 can be completed

acceptance.text: Case review shows the briefing with clickable citations, which rule or playbook produced each finding, model-versus-template disclosure, and whether the run is waiting for a human; a specialist can record an opinion through the existing decisions API
SYN-003 can be completed end to end in the UI (referral, specialist opinion, supervisor decision); accessibility checks pass; the agent's output is clearly a suggestion that never decides

Each AI-produced item shows its provenance (provider and model, local model or template) and the officer can mark a finding accepted, modified or rejected with a reason through the TAX-096 feedback operation
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: SYN-003 can be completed end to end in the UI (referral, specialist opinion, supervisor decision); accessibility checks pass; the agent's output is clearly a suggestion that never decides
